title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DIRECTING THE DEPARTMENT DEVELOPMENT (DSWD) TO EXERCISE OVERSIGHT FUNCTION OVER THE NATIONAL YOUTH COMMISSION (NYC)

text.en:
Without prejudice to the undertaking of their respective
functions, the DSWD shall exercise oversight function over the NYC, in order to
ensure completion and supplementation of support services for the youth and
sustain inter-agency and multi-sectoral efforts at the national, provincial,
city/ municipal and barangay level.

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.
PONA Hologram # 30517

2

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 10th day of
of our Lord, Two Thousand and Five.
POMA Hologram « 30518
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
